title: Quick Chicken Fricassee
description: A hearty Italian-inspired dish made with tender chicken, crunchy vegetables, and a hint of spices. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the tomato and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the red wine and chicken broth to the skillet, scraping up any browned bits.
Return the chicken to the skillet and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and cook, covered, until the chicken is cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
